jobs.description:
Position: Cloud Engineering – Architect (Java & AWS)

Location: Bangalore

Work Mode: Hybrid

Experience: 8+ Years

Position Summary

We are looking for a Cloud Engineering Architect with strong expertise in Java backend development, cloud-native architecture, and AWS engineering. The role focuses on designing and delivering scalable, resilient, event-driven microservices platforms on AWS while providing architectural leadership and technical governance.

The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on experience in Java (8–17), Spring Boot, Microservices, Kafka, Kubernetes, and AWS, along with proven experience modernizing enterprise systems into cloud-native architectures.

Key Responsibilities

• •

Architect and design scalable cloud-native solutions on AWS (EKS, ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, Redshift, Glue).

•

Lead microservices and event-driven architecture implementations using Java and Spring Boot.

•

Drive monolith-to-microservices modernization initiatives.

•

Define API contracts, domain models (DDD), and integration patterns.

•

Implement containerization using Docker and orchestration via Kubernetes.

•

Establish CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices.

•

Ensure system scalability, performance tuning, resilience, and cost optimization.

•

Provide architectural leadership, mentor engineering teams, and enforce coding standards.

•

Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.

Required Skills

• •

8+ years of strong Java backend development experience.

•

Expertise in Spring Boot, Microservices, and Distributed Systems.

•

Hands-on AWS experience (EKS, ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, SNS, API Gateway).

•

Strong experience with Kafka and event-driven systems.

•

Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.

•

Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis).

•

Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture, scalability, and resilience patterns.

Preferred

• •

AWS Certification.

•

Experience in large-scale enterprise or financial platforms.

•

Exposure to OLAP/Data Engineering (Redshift, Glue).

•

Strong leadership and stakeholder management experience.

Company: Crossing Infotech

Job Type: Full-time Internship

Work Mode: Virtual / Remote

Location: India

Internship Duration: 1–3 months

Stipend: 16,500/month

Application Deadline: 20 September 2026



About the opportunity



Crossing Infotech is offering a DevOps Engineer Internship for freshers and entry-level candidates interested in cloud computing, Linux administration, CI/CD, automation, containerization, and software deployment.



This internship provides practical exposure to DevOps workflows through supervised project activities involving source-code management, build and deployment pipelines, cloud environments, monitoring, troubleshooting, and infrastructure automation.



Key responsibilities



• Assist with configuring and maintaining development and deployment environments.

• Work with Linux-based systems and basic command-line operations.

• Support CI/CD pipeline creation and maintenance.

• Assist with automated build, testing, and deployment workflows.

• Use Git for source-code management and version control.

• Work with cloud platforms such as AWS or Microsoft Azure.

• Assist with deploying applications to development and test environments.

• Learn and work with containerization using Docker.

• Monitor basic application and deployment activity.

• Troubleshoot common build, deployment, and environment issues.

• Maintain configuration files and deployment documentation.

• Assist in automating repetitive development and operational tasks.

• Support environment setup and configuration activities.

• Follow security and access-control practices while working with development environments.

• Collaborate with developers and technical team members.



Who can apply



• Freshers and recent graduates.

• Candidates pursuing or having completed B.Tech, B.E., BCA, MCA, B.Sc. Computer Science, IT, or related programs.

• Candidates interested in cloud computing, DevOps, automation, or software infrastructure.

• Candidates with academic, personal, or lab projects involving Linux, cloud, or deployment technologies.



Required skills



• Basic understanding of software development and deployment processes.

• Basic knowledge of Linux and command-line operations.

• Familiarity with Git and version control.

• Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts.

• Basic understanding of cloud computing.

• Good problem-solving and troubleshooting ability.

• Basic scripting knowledge is an advantage.

• Willingness to learn DevOps tools and practices.



Preferred skills



• Familiarity with AWS or Microsoft Azure.

• Basic knowledge of Docker and containerization.

• Familiarity with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.

• Basic knowledge of YAML configuration files.

• Familiarity with shell scripting or Python.

• Understanding of networking fundamentals.

• Basic knowledge of application monitoring and logging.

• Familiarity with Kubernetes is an advantage.

• Experience with academic or personal DevOps projects.



What you will learn



• DevOps principles and software delivery workflows.

• Linux administration and command-line operations.

• Git and collaborative development practices.

• CI/CD pipeline concepts and automation.

• Cloud deployment fundamentals.

• Docker and containerization.

• Application deployment and environment management.

• Monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting basics.

• Infrastructure and deployment documentation.



Ideal candidate profile



We are looking for candidates who are:



• Interested in building a career in DevOps, cloud, or infrastructure engineering.

• Curious about how software is built, deployed, and maintained.

• Comfortable learning technical tools and command-line workflows.

• Good at troubleshooting and logical problem-solving.

• Willing to experiment in development and test environments.

• Detail-oriented when working with configurations and deployment processes.

• Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.



Why join Crossing Infotech



• Remote internship opportunity.

• Practical exposure to DevOps and cloud workflows.

• Experience with CI/CD, Git, Linux, and deployment practices.

• Opportunity to learn modern infrastructure and automation tools.

• Project-based learning suitable for freshers.

• Opportunity to develop skills relevant to DevOps and cloud engineering careers.



Application deadline: 20 September 2026



If you are a fresher interested in DevOps, cloud computing, automation, and software deployment, this internship provides an opportunity to develop practical infrastructure skills through structured projects and supervised technical activities.
